index.title: Welcome
index.description: Christ Church Coronado seeks a compassionate rector to lead our friendly Episcopal community in worship, service, and faith formation.

sections.heading: Welcome to Christ Church
content: We are a friendly, inclusive Episcopal community
in Coronado, California.
Our parish is home to over 200 members from all walks of life, including many
<a href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Naval_Air_Station_North_Island" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"
class="link">military families. We value tradition, thoughtful worship,
and caring for one another. Our motto "Bridging Love and Service" reflects our desire to grow a spiritual community in harmony with our surrounding secular community.
Christ Church Day School,
founded in 1957, is the only Episcopal elementary school in the <a href="https://edsd.org/" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"
class="link">Diocese of San Diego. We are committed to its future and to Christian education for all ages.
We seek an experienced leader who will work collaboratively with vestry, lay leaders, school, and staff.
We welcome all people and look forward to meeting our next rector. If you feel called, we hope to hear from you.
✞ The People of Christ Church

sections.heading: Our Hopes for Our Next Rector
content: <ul class="list-disc list-inside animated-list" id="rector-hopes">
• Lead us in service and outreach
• Grow our youth and family ministry
• Deepen our relationship with the Day School
• Welcome new members and enhance faith
• Support small groups and learning
• Offer caring support in all seasons
• Provide faithful stewardship and care

worship.title: Worship
worship.description: Join us for traditional Episcopal worship at Christ Church Coronado. Sundays at 8am (Rite I) and 10am (Rite II with choir).

sections.heading: Prayer, Eucharist, and fellowship
content: At Christ Church Coronado, worship is at the heart of who we are. We are a friendly,
inclusive community where everyone is invited to encounter God through prayer, sacrament, and fellowship.
All are welcome at Christ's table. Whether they are new, returning, or seeking, they are invited to join us.
Weekly Worship Schedule:
<ul class="list-disc list-inside">
• Sunday 8:00 am – Holy Eucharist (Rite I)
• Sunday 10:00 am – Holy Eucharist (Rite II, choir & organ)
• Tuesday 8:00 am – Holy Eucharist (Rite II, Day School Chapel)
• Thursday 8:00 am – Morning Prayer (with Class Chaplains)
• Wednesday 5:30 pm – Evening Prayer (lay led)
Most of our members value our traditional faith, but some would like more variety in worship, prayers, and music.
As we look to the future, we seek to honor the liturgical beauty that nourishes us while remaining open to new expressions of praise and prayer.

sections.heading: Altar Guild at Christ Church
content: The Altar Guild serves as an essential ministry in the life of our parish.
Working reverently and quietly behind the scene, members ensure that the altar is prepared and
set for every worship service. They also assist in preparing the church for special feast days,
baptisms, confirmations, weddings, funerals, and the services of Holy Week and Easter.
Altar Guild duties include caring for the sacred vessels, vestments, and altar linens.
Members polish the brass and silver. They clean and maintain the Sanctuary and Sacristy.
It is the duty of the Altar Guild to order the bread, wine, oil and supplies that are used
for all worship services. In lieu of a Flower Ministry, the Altar Guild coordinates with a
local florist to ensure beautiful flower arrangements that have liturgically correct colors
for weekly and special services. This ministry is grounded in prayer and attention to detail.
The Altar Guild members serve under the direction of the clergy and contribute meaningfully
to the reverence, beauty and smooth flow of our common prayer. Through their faithful service,
the Altar Guild creates a joyful and sacred space where our parish family gathers to encounter
Christ in Word and Sacrament.

youth_family.title: Youth & Family
youth_family.description: Youth and family ministry at Christ Church Coronado includes Sunday School, Kids Praise choir, and Camp Create summer VBS.

sections.heading: Growing in faith together
content: We welcome children, teens, and families to grow in faith together.
Worship at Christ Church is wiggle-friendly!
Families are always welcome to worship together during Sunday services.
Children’s worship materials are available in the first pew
prayground
to help engage young hearts and minds.
Our youth ministries include:
<ul class="list-disc list-inside">
• Weekly Godly Play story circles and Youth Group every other Sunday.
• Participation in diocesan children and youth events nurturing a broader faith community.
• Summer Vacation Bible School.
• Intergenerational worship, events, and programming.
• Opportunities to serve Sunday mornings and in Outreach.

service_ministry.title: Service Ministry
service_ministry.description: Christ Church Coronado's service ministry includes refugee support, food drives, and partnerships with St. Mark's and SDOP.

sections.heading: Bridging love and service
content: <div class="flex-content">
<div class="flex-1">
Our Service Ministry helps our parish live an active, visible faith. Meeting monthly, this core group of volunteers
plans outreach efforts for the church community. Our parish community not only provides financial support as it offers
hands-on opportunities, allowing for involvement in our spiritual call to help others. While some activities are held at
church, others involve heading over the bridge to <a href="https://stmarks-cityheights.org/" target="_blank"
rel="noopener noreferrer" class="link">St. Mark's and
target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" class="link">St. Luke's parishes to provide support for the unhoused and those in need.
As James 2:17 reminds us, "faith without works is dead". Guided by that call, we raise funds for
Vida Joven
through our annual festive Cinco de Mayo dinner, which provides shelter for orphans in Tijuana and Northern Mexico.
The Backpack Drive provides over 200 backpacks filled with school supplies for children, and our Thanksgiving Drive
works with Christ Church Day School to collect food and financial donations to provide food for 200 families.
We share the joy of Advent by providing Christmas gifts for the <a href="https://episcopalcommunityservices.org/"
target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" class="link">Episcopal Community Services Head Start programs.
And our Lenten Drive annually supports causes the Service Ministry team identifies to serve those in need.
This year we are assisting RefugeeNet to send children to summer swim lessons and robotics camp.
In recent years, we revived "Blessings in a Bag", a tradition of practical care for neighbors experiencing homelessness
by equipping parishioners with small gift bags of food and essentials to share with dignity and kindness.
Our Thrift Shop, by raising over $100,000 per year, extends this outreach as a community ministry, supported by
volunteers and donors beyond our congregation. Ongoing, Christ Church partners with St. Mark's to support their
Food Pantry, now serving 400 families weekly.

Peace & Justice Committee
Christ Church also has a Peace & Justice Committee. During COVID, parishioners participated in the Episcopal Church's
Sacred Ground program, which deepened our commitment to faithful action and honest conversation. From that work,
we sensed a call to engage issues affecting our neighbors, and we joined the <a href="https://sdop.org/"
target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" class="link">San Diego Organizing Project (SDOP), a non-partisan,
multi-faith network. Through listening and discernment, we focused first on housing, homelessness, and ocean pollution,
supporting efforts such as renter protections, housing initiatives, and practical support for the unhoused.
More recently, we have felt a clear call toward immigration and refugee support. We have hosted Home Meetings,
participated in forums and rallies, and held discussions on issues including refugee resettlement.
In collaboration with Our Lady of Guadalupe Church and SDOP, we now support the <a href="https://sdop.net/faith-accompaniment-ministry"
target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" class="link">FAITH program (Faithful Accompaniment
in Trust & Hope), offering moral support and prayerful presence for migrants at court hearings and related sites.

day_school.description: Christ Church Day School is a thriving JK-8 Episcopal school in Coronado, serving 130 students with small classes since 1957.

sections.heading: A thriving Episcopal school in the heart of Coronado
content: <div class="flex-content">
<div class="flex-1">
Christ Church Day School
(CCDS) is a vital mission of Christ Church, serving JK–8th grade with 130 students in small classes.
Founded in 1957, CCDS provides quality education grounded in Christian values.
It is accredited by the <a href="https://acswasc.org/" target="blank" rel="noopener"
class="link">Western Association of Schools and Colleges (WASC) and a member of the
<a href="https://www.episcopalschools.org/" target="blank" rel="noopener"
class="link">National Association of Episcopal Schools (NAES)
<div class="stats-grid">

Enrollment
130 students, JK–8

Class sizes
Small (about 14–16)

Founded
1957
Students receive rich specialty programs including Spanish, Music, Physical Education, Art, and Spiritual Nurture.
CCDS hosts twice-weekly all-school chapels with Eucharist on Tuesdays and Morning Prayer on Thursdays.
CCDS keeps the campus alive and vibrant with open houses, back-to-school events, an annual Harvest Festival,
movie nights on the lawn, music and talent performances, family nights, pet blessings, Scholastic Book Fairs,
and end-of-year celebrations. The school partners frequently with the church on service projects,
including our annual Spaghetti Dinner and Thanksgiving Food Drive.
Learn more at ccds.org.

thrift_shop.title: Thrift Shop
thrift_shop.description: Christ Church Thrift Shop has served Coronado for 70+ years, raising over $100,000 annually for parish ministries and outreach.

sections.heading: Joining God's work in the world
content: <div class="flex-content">
<div class="flex-1">
One of the most significant and impactful ministries of Christ Church is our Thrift Shop.
In operation for over 75 years, it is managed and staffed entirely by nearly 50 volunteers from
Christ Church and the surrounding community. All proceeds support a wide range of parish activities
and outreach efforts at the diocesan, national, and international levels. In 2025 alone, over $100,000
in funds were provided to worthwhile ministries, including <a href="https://ccds.org"
target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" class="link">Christ Church Day School, the
San Diego Food Bank,
World Central Kitchen,
PAWS
(our local animal welfare group), <a href="https://vjkids.org/" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"
class="link">Vida Joven (a foundation that supports orphanages in Mexico),
target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" class="link">The Episcopal Refugee Network, and various other projects
of The Episcopal Diocese of San Diego.
Beyond its vital financial outreach, the Thrift Shop provides help to low-income families by offering quality merchandise at
very low cost. It also creates fellowship for volunteers and shoppers who've developed relationships over the years. The shop
is open for sales and donations on Tuesday through Saturday, 10 am to 1 pm.
The Thrift Shop embodies our call to service in tangible, practical ways, connecting commerce with compassion and stewardship with generosity.

music_ministry.title: Music Ministry
music_ministry.description: Music ministry is central to worship at Christ Church Coronado, featuring our choir, organ, and sacred music traditions.

sections.heading: Music at Christ Church
content: For centuries, music has been closely connected with faith
and worship. At Christ Church, singing, hymns, and the organ continue this long
tradition of Anglican worship, inviting everyone to take part. Music has a unique
power: it lifts the words of the liturgy, highlights important moments in the
service, and brings depth and beauty that spoken words alone cannot always express.
Through psalms, hymns, and choral music, the congregation shares in prayer and
praise together.
Music also draws people together. When voices join in song,
a sense of unity and encouragement is created, strengthening both the community
and the faith of each individual. Sacred music expresses the wide range of
emotions found in worship—joy, sorrow, thanksgiving, and hope—and offers a way
to respond to God in a universal language understood by all.
At Christ Church, music is therefore more than a background to worship—
it is an essential part of it. Whether through the choir, the organ, or the
congregation singing as one, music enriches the liturgy, marks important
moments of prayer and praise, and helps us experience God’s presence and
love in a meaningful way.
